description: A Perl script that generates a mime types configuration file (mimetypes.conf) from the system's /etc/mime.types, including custom rules and extensions, intended for configuring or generating mime type mappings for a web server or application.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Assigns a MIME type to a file extension in the %extensions hash.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or merges a MIME type for a given extension, resolving conflicts according to rules.

methods.name: print_type
methods.description: Prints a MIME type mapping, appending charset for text types when applicable.

methods.name: mimecmpvalue
methods.description: Helper function to compare MIME types with special ordering for x- and vnd. types.
